newsitem.title: USA: Lilly Industries Q1 results 'on target'.
newsitem.headline: Lilly Industries Q1 results 'on target'.

text.p: Lilly Industries Inc said Monday earnings for the fiscal first quarter ended February 28 of $0.20 a share, up from $0.15 a year ago, were in line with its expectations.
"Our first quarter results were on target with our projections," Douglas Huemme, chairman, said in a statement.

Sales for the quarter rose to a record of $142.2 million from $73.3 million a year ago. The improvement in sales reflected the contribution from Guardsman Products Inc, which was acquired in April 1996, and operations in its core businesses, Lilly said.

The company said earnings for the quarter were up despite unspecified one-time costs for new manufacturing facilities. These costs included start-up expenses for three new facilities in Bowling Green, Ky., Charlotte, N.C., and Ballinamore, Ireland.
Selling, administrative and general expenses for the first quarter rose to $34.0 million from $14.9 million.
"Investments in new facilities are needed to satisfy customer requirements in 1998 and beyond," Huemme said.
Lilly Industries makes industrial coatings and specialty chemical products.
